notes: LTX 2.5 is a current v1.1 local family. Execution identity is ltx-2.5-distilled, never ltx-local.
Local Text-to-Video uses ltx_25.t2v when that workflow is installed.
Start Frame uses ltx_25.i2v and requires one start image.
Start + End Frame uses LTXVAddGuide at frame 0 and frame -1, then LTXVCropGuides. A third frame is not a mode.
